title: Measures Of Economic Growth
definition: Measures of economic growth quantify the quantitative increase in a nation's production of goods and services over a specific period, primarily tracked through metrics like Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross National Product (GNP), and their real versus nominal adjustments.
importanceInUpsc: This microtopic forms the bedrock of the Indian Economy syllabus for UPSC CSE Prelims (standard definitions, base year revisions, real vs. nominal GDP) and Mains GS-3 (inclusive growth, resource allocation, and structural transformation).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Measures Of Economic Growth.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of macroeconomics and circular flow of income
